notes: Every mid-rise entry landing (door kind unit, lobby or porch) and ramp the game builds, as drawn: block and face name the building block and its footprint edge, station_m the door's (or ramp's) span along that block's face, top_xz its top's plan corners in world x/z (metres, +x east, +z south), top_y_m its top height (a ramp's at each end), and a door's recess_xz the plan corners of its recess floor, between the jambs from the wall line to the door, at the same height.

tools/build_godot_world.mjs reads this file: no plant, hedge or prop stands on a landing, the street ground's grass and mulch beside one are paved, park and lot ground stops at a landing's top and a door's recess floor, and a sidewalk a landing stands up out of is cut at its outline. Regenerate it with tools/export_door_landings.gd after a change that moves a mid-rise door; its --check (tools/test.sh) fails while the file differs from what the game builds.
producer: tools/export_door_landings.gd: game/scripts/world/facades/midrise_family.gd _build_all and _check_built over game/resources/housing_family/live_instances.json and the frozen wall and land records of generated/world/chunks
